# BridgeForge probe profile grammar parity fixture (roadmap P3c-1).

# Both parsers must agree on this exact file:
#   - Python: bridgeforge/probe_config.py's parse_profile, asserted against it in
#     tests/test_probe_profile.py (ProbeProfileParityTests).
#   - Java: probe-mod/src/com/bridgeforge/probe/ProbeProfile.java hand-parses the identical
#     grammar (same keywords, same '#'/'-'/case/whitespace rules) but has no JVM test harness in
#     this repo to run it against a file at test time; its javadoc restates the same rules so a
#     change on either side is easy to notice against the other. Any change to this fixture's
#     expected setups list in the Python test should be mirrored by re-reading ProbeProfile.java's
#     grammar description.
